title: BACKND Base friend
summary: Friend system: list friends (GetFriendList with limit/offset), send a friend request, list sent/received requests, accept/refuse/cancel a request, and delete a friend.
capabilities: route friend list, request, accept/refuse, and delete questions
describe limit/offset paging for friend lists
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
Target gamer inDate is known when sending a request
common_pitfalls: Not handling duplicate or already-friend request responses
Ignoring paging on large friend lists
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating friend code.
Confirm request lifecycle and error handling upstream.
public_notes: Friend requests have a send/receive/accept-refuse-cancel lifecycle.
Friend-related realtime events relate to the notify topic.
